_notes: Images as UQM 0.8.0's own PNG loader (TFB_png_to_sdl, over libpng and a stand-in for SDL 1.2) loads them. Each result is [0] if it doesn't load, or [1, bits per pixel, has alpha, width, height, colour key or -1, palette (256 RGB entries in hex, entries the PNG doesn't set are 0; "" without a palette), pixels (rows without padding, in hex)].
own: images of our own for each path through the loader, given in full (png in hex) with their results.

content: up to 40 of each kind of PNG (colour type, bit depth, interlace, transparency) in the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef), by path, with the SHA-256 of the result as compact JSON, since images are content.
